title: Chapter 827
paragraphs: Chapter 827
Episode 208. The Barmel Alliance Does Its Thing (4)

As the red owl finished its space leap, the landscape that appeared was a beach filled with the Milky Way. It was the area of the Shucheron Kingdom, which Jin had visited in the past to meet the contractor of Olmang after he became a cavalier.
"Ugh... It seems I have nothing to throw up now. Damn it, Leot! How could you humiliate me like this...?"
"Don't be too harsh on him, Murakan. He thought of you even in his busy schedule and drew it with all his heart."
"The next time I go to the Garden of Swords, I won't leave him alone... seriously."
Murakan looked at the tavern on the beach with a sullen face. A warm orange light gently lit up the surroundings. It was the tavern where Olmang's contractor, Jogervi, worked.
And now, not only Olmang, but Keitam, Ox, and Telpen were also occupying that tavern. The safe zone they requested because they wanted to go to Jin was this tavern.
Jin and Murakan stared at the tavern and were momentarily immersed in their memories.
Moments of their first vacation together with the Tikan colleagues, and the memory of meeting Sara after opening the second tomb of Temar, which was sealed in a huge clam underwater, came to mind.
"Oh, Lord Jin!"
[Jin?]
[It's Jin!]
Olmang's contractor Jogervi, Ox (the God of Frame), and Telpen (the God of Pencil) greeted Jin. The three of them were in the middle of a card game.
"It's been a while. Have you gods been well?"
"Hello."
[Mu, Murakan!?]
[Murakan you say!?]
"Ah, stop being surprised every time you see me! I'm not that old nutcase anymore."
[Hmmm. I see.]
[I heard you've almost regained your old power, congratulations.]
"Thank you."
Ox and Telpen smiled awkwardly. And Jin looked at the two gods with curiosity.
'They are gods who can appear as they please even without a contractor because their divine power is too low...'
Ox and Telpen were literally the lowliest of the lowliest gods. Some academic circles classified them not as gods but as spirits or special creatures.
'Like Olmang, do these two also have some special abilities?'
Just as he was curious, Jogervi rolled his eyes and called Olmang.
[Jin! It's Jin! Did you bring the Sour Crunchy Litra Cookie...!]
"Because of the story about Keitam, I forgot to bring it, Olmang. But Tikan should have been sending quite a lot of cookies regularly."
[Hmm... Ever since these guys came, there have been no leftover cookies. Since the number of mouths has increased by three, we need three times more. As a result, we end up just eating shellfish.]
"Anyway, every time I see that clam god, he only talks about cookies. I like Yeonggi the most."
[Your god probably doesn't like Yeonggi much, Murakan. I bet Soldierlet would want to consume something other than Yeonggi, right?]
"Let's say you're right. Anyway, I have some business with that painter god or whatever, so let's finish up quickly. I'm busy. Come to think of it, I don't see him."
[Keitam is in the other room, working with his contractor.]
Keitam was the only god among the newcomers here who had a contractor.
"Working? What kind of work?"
[What kind of work would a painter god do? Obviously, he's painting. So, wait a bit, if you bother him during work....]
Bang! Before Olmang could finish, Murakan flung the door open. The room was covered in canvases and easels, and a man and Keitam, who had turned into a painting god, were seen in deep thought.
"Aargh! What the hell is this, I pleaded not to be disturbed during work!"
[Who is it, what bastard did this? Must be crazy to die. Are you not afraid to incur the wrath of a god... Mu, Murakan? Hey, Olmang, is this guy Murakan...?]
"…Lord Jin?"
Upon seeing the two, the man and Keitam dropped their anger and relaxed.

"Oh, Lord Jin. If you had informed me in advance, I would have waited outside. Oh, I apologize for showing this odd behavior. I get a bit sensitive during my work, so I ended up making a mistake by not recognizing even Lord Jin. I was in the middle of painting the Garden of Swords."
The man was Billy, Keitam's contractor.

[Well, nice to meet you. Murakan, I'm the painter god, Keitam. You may not know me, but I had a rather significant relationship with Soldierlet... and I'm the god who granted his important request. So, I yelled a bit in surprise, so don't hit me.]
"Sorry about that, you seemed to be concentrating on something. I was a bit hasty because I wanted to get home quickly."

[No, no. Don't worry about it. After all, I was the one who called Jin and you. It's rather that I couldn't greet you properly... But this guy! Just because you're Murakan, do you think you can do anything? Do you know how difficult it is for me right now!? Those damn Zipl guys are trembling with some kind of plague, the work doesn't come out, my masterpiece is in a mess as if it's stricken with a plague, do you guys understand this feeling!?]
"Ke, Keitam. Calm down."
[Let go, Billy, let go! I'll kill that guy today and then die myself!]
Murakan was freshly shocked at this.

"Oh, right. Regardless of whether a god is weak or strong, this kind of temperament should be there. If he doesn't calm down even after knowing who I am, here's some cold water (Olmang handed it). That's right, drink it all in one gulp."
"Phew! Now my senses are back properly. Please understand, Murakan. I'm a bit crazy when I get interrupted during these times."
"It happens. I've seen a few art gods behave like that in the old days. But why did you call me and the kid?"
[It's because of my masterpiece.]
"Masterpiece?"
[Yes, a piece of work that I've poured everything into. Even as a god of painters, it's so perfect that I can't paint it again...]
Tears welled up in Keitam's eyes. Naturally, Murakan comforted him by patting his shoulder.
And Jin, from the moment he entered the studio, couldn't take his eyes off the artworks filling the walls.

He was momentarily spellbound by the indescribably beautiful pictures. Landscape paintings, portraits, even abstract paintings drawn haphazardly like doodles. Wherever his gaze fell, he was taken aback, and his mind reeled. If it were not a god of painting, or his contractor, it would have been impossible to paint like this.
"All the works here look like masterpieces, Lord Keitam."
[These are nothing more than mediocre compared to that one.]
"What piece is it?"
[This piece.]
What Keitam pointed to was the piece that he and Billy had been working on, which looked like a board painted black.
Perhaps because of his skill, the blackboard seemed to hide something profound.
"Isn't it just painted black?"
[To your eyes, it might look that way. But this is not just a picture, it's a space.]
"A space?"
[Yes, Murakan. The space depicted on this board can only be recognized by me and Billy. Also, only I can enter, only I can modify, and only I can control the space... it was.]
"Please explain it in a way I can understand."
[This painting is a subspace drawn on commission from Soldierlet.]
"Do you mean Temar's Tomb?"
[Yes, exactly. It's a picture that was used as Temar's tomb. Soldierlet buried Temar here and not long after, relocated him to another place. And this work became entirely my property...]
Murakan had felt hurt about the fact that Soldierlet left his keepsakes without his knowledge to Piconi or Olmang.
But it wasn't like that now. He believed that if he approached the truth with Jin, naturally, the day would come when he understood Soldierlet's intentions.
"......Please continue."

[Soldorette didn't tell me anything special. He didn't prophecy that a contracted party would appear after a thousand years, like he told Olmang. He just told me with a tired face. This relocation is not due to Jipil's chase like other tombs, so I can live at ease. Jipil does not know that I helped him.]
Jipil didn't know that Keitam had helped Soldorette. If he knew, there would be no chance for him to meet Jin and Murakan now.
"Didn't Soldorette explain why he moved Temar?"

[No. Perhaps it was a consideration to keep me out of the loop. From the beginning, when he asked for the painting, Soldorette didn't seem well. I accepted the request as it was an opportunity to create a masterpiece, but I did not want to get involved in your war. It's a shameful story, but I was afraid. As the god of painters, I just wanted to bless the painters.]
"Has your mind changed because I recently guaranteed your safety, Keitam?"

[That's not the only reason, but to be completely honest, it's because my work suddenly got damaged. And if it gets more damaged than it is now, the events of a thousand years ago that I captured in my work will disappear completely. I felt that the entities worthy of viewing the work, should take a look at it before that happens.]
The 'entities worthy of viewing the work' Keitam mentioned were Soldorette, or those who were deeply related to him. It was Jin, Murakan, and Misha who fit that description.
"You captured an event from a thousand years ago in your work. You, like Olmang, hid an incredible ability. Do Oxe and Telpen also do that?"
[We don't have that kind of thing, Murakan.]
[Yup, we just help Keitam by making frames and sharpening pencils.]
"I see. So, what happened a thousand years ago that you captured in your work, Keitam?"

[That's the problem, I can't remember. It was clear down to the smallest detail until recently, but since the work was polluted, it became hard to recall. But Murakan, I'm sure it was about you. That's why I called Jin as soon as I heard about you.]
"It's a story related to me......"

"Keitam, you said that the work suddenly got damaged and since then you cannot remember the content. Then it is likely Jipil's history manipulation, but Jipil doesn't know that you helped Soldorette, right?"

[It's more likely not history manipulation, Jin. This work is my masterpiece as I mentioned before, where I gave my all. Since the work itself is closely linked to the mental world, problems arise in my memory when the work is damaged.]
"I'm starting to understand. So, the kid and I should go into the picture, check what happened a thousand years ago before it gets more damaged, right?"
[Exactly.]
"It would be even better if we find who damaged the picture in the process?"
[Right. It would be great if you could find them.]
"Good, it's simple. We can enter right away, so let's get ready quickly."

[......It might not be as easy as you think, Murakan. Inside the picture are guardians that I drew. Originally, it was a picture to be used as Temar's tomb. And those guardians, being a picture, are portrayed very powerfully according to my wish.]
